analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW: The market is in a MIXED regime (SPY -0.1% vs SMA50 but positive 20d slope), which is not a high-confidence entry environment. More importantly, the portfolio's own track record demands humility: 0% win rate on 8 closed trades, all stopped out, with an avg loss of -5.10% and a Sortino of -13.85. This is a critical signal — the style is either entering too early, stops are being set in noise-prone zones, or the macro backdrop has been unfavorable for mean-reversion entries. The correct response is NOT to add more trades to manufacture activity.

POSITION REVIEWS:
- AMP (-12.19%, $9,128): This is the most urgent concern. At $480.41 vs avg entry $547.12, AMP is well below any ATR-based stop that should have been set (~1.5-2x ATR below $547). If a stop was set at ~$510-520, it was violated long ago. If not set correctly, this is a lesson in discipline. The position should be reviewed manually for thesis-break — Ameriprise is sensitive to wealth management flows, rate expectations, and market levels. At -12.19%, continued holding requires strong fundamental conviction that is hard to maintain given the price action.
- IT (+12.56%): Best performer. Gartner is a high-quality compounder. Thesis intact; hold.
- ULTA (+6.40%): Decent recovery. Hold with trailing awareness near prior support.
- FOXA (+2.59%): Modest gain. No thesis break visible. Hold.
- NVDA (-0.82%): Essentially flat. Thesis (AI infrastructure demand) intact long-term. Hold.

NEW TRADES: Already at 5 positions (ceiling of 3-5). With a 0% win rate on 8 trades, adding more risk is precisely the wrong move. The most interesting candidate is ADSK (PEG 0.81, ROE 53.9%, FCF $3.2B, 42% of range, basing) but the SMA50 slope is -0.1% (no confirmed upward inflection) and adding a 6th position violates concentration discipline. TRMB has earnings in 15 days — binary event risk. BR stopped us out previously. MPC/APA/EOG are at 97-100% of 52w range (late-cycle extended, explicitly avoided per rules). Cash is the correct incremental position. The $27.5k in cash is earning its keep as dry powder. Discipline means doing nothing when there is nothing genuinely asymmetric to do.
